objective: Cloud-only continuity closure: re-sync from GitHub, root-cause the AppArmor sandbox blocker, make isolation handling vendor-neutral, inventory every real worker this cloud environment can actually run, validate what is genuinely validatable, and record an honest verdict without touching production.
tests_run: npm ci; full node --test; focused continuity suite; docs path-reference and Hermes separation suites; npm run db:replay against a real local PostgreSQL 14
decisions: The 2026-10-02 VPS AppArmor/namespace failure is HOST-SPECIFIC: in this Freebuff container unshare --user succeeds, no AppArmor module is loaded, and codex sandbox linux executes successfully. The Continuity runtime is not the cause, and no host security was relaxed or bypassed.

Sandbox failures are now classified by a shared vendor-neutral detector (SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE) instead of one adapter's literal bwrap wording, and every external worker can declare a host isolation probe (verifySandbox) that fails closed before any turn starts.
The Codex and Claude Code adapters stay IMPLEMENTED / TESTED IN CODE / LIVE CERTIFICATION DEFERRED and remain disabled in production.

Three stale uncommitted 2026-10-01 local edits were inspected, found superseded by the remote branch history, backed up outside the repository and discarded; their still-unique findings were carried into docs/HANDOVER.md.
Production stays untouched: no merge, no retarget, no migration, no deploy, no flag change, no force push, no Hermes access.
Automatic GitHub validate passed on the closure code head 8435683 (run 37066180321); this documentation follow-up runs its own validate and is inspected, never rerun.
constraints: Do not merge #102, #104, #105, #106, #107 or #108, retarget PRs, apply the production migration, deploy, or enable CONTINUITY_SUPERVISOR / CONTINUITY_CODEX_ENABLED / CONTINUITY_CLAUDE_ENABLED.
Do not disable AppArmor or any host sandbox, and do not bypass a worker's isolation layer to make a drill pass.
Do not claim worker execution that did not happen, and do not rerun CI manually; only inspect results.
